spec.assertion: Structural: trigger hitCount count=36, target enemy. Fails under an interval trigger, a different threshold, or a shotFired keying. Non-vacuity comes from the DOT_ZERO delta being > 0 (the fixture demonstrably reaches 36 hits).

dot effect atkPct 52.24, durationSec 5, intervalSec 1, flavor 'sustained'. Behavioural: doubling durationSec to 10 roughly doubles the DoT contribution (ratio in 1.7-2.3), which fails under a maintained/longer-window encoding where the baseline already carries the larger value.

A targetStatus effect named /hack/i with durationSec >= 5 must exist, on BOTH Hacked-labelled S1 lines. Fails if the status channel is omitted — in which case S2's gate can never open and the whole S2 line is silently inert.

A burstCast-triggered block carrying the same 52.24%/5s DoT, plus a global assertion that NO block uses fullBurstEnter. Fails under the over-crediting fullBurstEnter keying, which in this comp would fire on liter-led rotations kurumi never cast.

Structural: single skill2 block, hitCount 36 + fbGate 'inFb' + requiresTargetStatus /hack/i, target enemy. Behavioural: removing fbGate raises kurumi total (the gate is load-bearing); removing the targetStatus SOURCE removes exactly the same damage as deleting the whole skill2 block (within 1%), which fails both if the status gate is unmodelled and if Hacked leaks into any other line.

flatDamage atkPct 86.17 with core not true (the text never says core strike damage) and noFb not true (riders take Full Burst by timing; per-kit noFb is measured-only). Fails under a core-tagged or FB-exempt rider.

Single burstCast block, target enemy, one buff effect damageTakenPct 18.06 durationSec 10 and NOTHING else (it is a boss debuff, not a self/ally buff). Behavioural provenance: zero 18.06 damageTakenPct buffApply events once the burst block is removed, and every baseline apply is boss-held (casterIdx and targetIdx both null). Fails if the line is encoded as an ally-side amplifier or sourced elsewhere.

Teammate totals byte-identical across all four damage-line counterfactuals (her damage lines are enemy-scoped and grant nothing to the team); block counts 2/1/1 across the slots so no kit line is dropped.

fixtures: controlComp('kurumi', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / kurumi / helm B3, deterministic, no seed. The fixed B3 (helm) is kept because kurumi is Burst I: without a B1+B2+B3 chain there are no Full Bursts at all and the entire skill2 line (fbGate 'inFb') would be vacuous. helm's buffs do not confound any assertion here, since every claim is either structural or a within-fixture delta. 7 hoisted 180s runs: baseline plus 6 counterfactuals (DoT percentage zeroed, DoT duration 5->10, targetStatus stripped, skill2 removed, skill2 fbGate removed, burst slot removed). KNOWN LIMIT: kurumi is Burst I and liter occupies B1 in the control comp, so kurumi may never cast her own burst — the two burstCast-keyed lines are covered structurally plus by a provenance relation that holds at zero casts, with the one cast-dependent assertion explicitly labelled NON-VACUITY / fixture probe.
gaps: it.skip — exact Hacked window length: the kit states no duration for the status, only for the DoT. 5s (the DoT's own duration) is the inferred read and the test asserts >= 5s rather than pinning it; a popup/footage measurement of the last S2 proc following the final 36th hit would fix it. FLAG (outside the input domain).
